# mappings/UNICODE.txt - the 1:1 Unicode Bridge (starter)
# Base SUCS codepoints 0x00000000-0x0010FFFF correspond 1:1 with Unicode
# codepoints of the same numeric value. sucs_downcast() of a bridged
# codepoint yields the identical Unicode value.
DIRECTION  bi-directional, lossless
RANGE      00000000-0010FFFF
NOTE       Mappings for native allocations are per-plugin (Extended tree).
